name: Yampa River — Duffy Mountain to East Cross Mountain
blurb: Quiet Class I–II floating through Juniper Canyon and the Maybell valley on Yampa River State Park sites.

timing.note: A reviewed speed/flow calibration has not been established. Access and guide information remain available.

sections.notes: Mileage: CPW Yampa River State Park river sections. CPW low-water advisory posted for Yampa River State Park (as of 6-23-2026); check CPW before launching.

notices.title: Low-water advisory
notices.text: CPW posted a low-water advisory dated June 23, 2026, still present when checked October 26. Downstream travel was discouraged. Check the agency for current conditions.
